answer: Witnessed Availability Ledger. Each identity must keep a karst node online and answer random 2-second liveness challenges; a jetty relay chain timestamps replies. Registration requires 30 days of continuous uptime with 99% challenge response before any action is permitted, and missing 5 challenges voids the identity. An attacker pays 30 days of real compute per identity plus maintaining distinct relay paths, making bulk sybils costly. Lotus seals each reply.
